verdict.rationale: Evidence only tangentially touches documentation: Agent Mode can be asked to 'write documentation' (postman-docs-33), and Spec Hub/collections are described as ways to 'design' APIs (postman-docs-16, postman-docs-38, postman-docs-54), but no citation explicitly describes generating or publishing shareable API documentation from a collection/spec, which is a well-known Postman feature. Missing for 10: explicit doc-generation/publish workflow evidence, publish-to-web or versioned docs pages, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of the documentation publishing experience.
